# M0-S5: an explicit logos.toml cgo policy wins over CGO_ENABLED in
# both directions, and Go modules keep upstream CGO_ENABLED handling.
# Every phase sets CGO_ENABLED explicitly so phases stay hermetic.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Default CC: a host compiler setting must not drive the build.
env CC=

# Explicit forbid stays enforced with CGO_ENABLED=1.
cd forbid
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] ! logos build .
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
cd ..

# Restricted keeps its allowlist with CGO_ENABLED=1.
cd res
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] logos build -o ok.bin ./ok
[cgo] ! logos build ./bad
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] package example\.com/m/bad uses cgo and is not in cgo_allowlist'
cd ..

# Restricted keeps its allowlist with CGO_ENABLED=0: explicit wins the
# other way too.
cd res
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=0
[cgo] logos build -o ok.bin ./ok
[cgo] ! logos build ./bad
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] package example\.com/m/bad uses cgo and is not in cgo_allowlist'
cd ..

# Explicit allow stays enabled with CGO_ENABLED=0.
cd allow
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=0
[cgo] logos build .
cd ..

# No cgo key with CGO_ENABLED=0 stays disabled.
cd nokey
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=0
[cgo] ! logos build .
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
cd ..

# A Go module with no logos.toml keeps upstream handling: logos build
# and go build agree.
cd gom
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] logos build .
[cgo] go build .
cd ..

# A cgo key in a Go module's logos.toml has no effect: CGO_ENABLED=1
# still builds its cgo package under logos build.
cd goign
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] logos build .
cd ..

-- forbid/go.mod --
module example.com/cgoforbid

go 1.27

-- forbid/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- forbid/main.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("forbid:", C.answer()) }

-- res/go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.27

-- res/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "restricted"
cgo_allowlist = ["example.com/m/ok/**"]

-- res/ok/ok.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("ok:", C.answer()) }

-- res/bad/bad.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("bad:", C.answer()) }

-- allow/go.mod --
module example.com/cgoallow

go 1.27

-- allow/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- allow/main.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("allow:", C.answer()) }
